# Clavis Encrypt 3.13.1

## 🛠️ Fixes

- **Sidebar:** all menu items now fit at the normal window size; "Settings" was cut off at the bottom. The window opens a little taller, and on small screens the menu scrolls as before.
- **Tamil:** the sidebar's subtitle under "Clavis Encrypt" is no longer cut off.
- **Find sensitive files:** the "never suggest" list is now stored with this PC's own random salt, so a copy of your settings can't be used to check a guessed file location. Files you hid in 3.13.0 stay hidden.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
